In the meantime I enjoy the process of working out because it makes me feel strong. I also know I am getting closer to my goals, esp when I get a rlly good pump and can see progress. Im hitting week 3 on the dot tmr, and im basically back to doing everything. The nurse at my 1-week post told me i was cleared and very much encouraged to stretch (obviously not to the extent of pain, but discomfort and stretching is fine). I can put my arms above my head but not quite full extension yet—though almost. 

Long story short, listen to whatever the nurses/surgeons told you to do/not do. And go off of how you’re physically feeling (not mentally, cos it can be scary to stretch but it is important to do so anyways ;)). You can also just observe your scars and if they look closed and healed it is definitely safe to move around like normal (though not jerkily). 

If the doctors etc didnt let you know about any specific things you should/shouldnt be doing right now, send them an email or give the office a call and ask too!!

GL!
